about: Public summary of the members-only entitled land list (land for sale approved, or zoned, for a 30 to 50 home townhome-style tax credit deal). Sites, sources and contacts are on the members page; this file carries only counts by region and one-line findings with no site named.

findings.finding: The entitled land list now covers every Colorado region: 18 sites, 6 approved for 30 or more homes.
A Mountains site is listed with an approved plan for 49 townhomes, the best new fit for a 30 to 50 home deal.
Town records show two Western Slope sites listed as entitled are not: one plat has been under city review since 2023, and one approval likely lapsed in April 2026.
No entitled or zoned site was found for sale in the San Luis Valley or the Eastern Plains.
